description: Built into the game: attack helicopters for ground support in NORMAL, TANK and AVIATION battles. Vanguard flies the AH-1Z Viper and AH-64E Apache, Onyx the Mi-24V Hind and Ka-52 Alligator (coaxial rotors). A chin gun that follows your sight, guided anti-tank missiles (Hellfire, Shturm, Vikhr) and rocket pods. Mouse or drag aims and turns, W/S (the stick) fly forward and back, A/D sideways, Shift/Z or the UP/DOWN buttons climb and descend. Every so often your side's helicopters get a GROUND SUPPORT MISSION: destroy enemy armour or clear infantry at a flag, or knock out an installation; finishing one costs the enemy 15 tickets. Enemy infantry fire shoulder-launched missiles (flares help) and tank crews shoot at helicopters hovering low. Research them in the AIRCRAFT tree. Every tank carries two salvos of smoke grenades against their missiles (V, or SMOKE on a phone): a missile can't lock on to a tank in its smoke, and bot crews fire theirs when one comes for them.
